This ceiling prevents generation-token truncation, but does not guarantee the four-hour wall limit.

findings.topic: Technical-stop and missing-outcome semantics conflict with the frozen evaluator
evidence: gnrl/evaluate.py:116 catches each environment exception, records success=False and error, then continues the game loop.
gnrl/evaluate.py:132 and :133 produce success_rate_attempted and planned lower-bound values that include technical rows in denominators.
Candidate fixed_budgets_and_failures requires stopping at the first technical failure and says technical missing outcomes must not be counted as scientific failure.
findings.required_resolution: The later reviewed controller must detect technical error records without reading success fields and stop/clean its owned evaluation process at that boundary, or the candidate must explicitly define stop-after-the-current-stage before adoption. Reporting must not treat the existing evaluator success=False/error rows or planned lower bounds as complete confirmation outcomes. Record every planned seed/task/arm cell as observed 0/1 only for completed scientific episodes, technical_error or missing otherwise; retain errors, attempted/completed/missing counts and costs. Suppress primary contrasts, practical pass/fail and completed-subset comparisons whenever any of the 1206 required cells is technical/missing. Define that a terminal incomplete report is still emitted even though all-nine performance unblinding is unavailable.

findings.topic: The current token audit and queue cannot directly execute the new seeds/budgets
evidence: gnrl/successful_path_token_audit_v1.py audit() calls sample_indices(len(keys)) with its default seed42 and reports seed42 settings.
scripts/run_successful_path_learning_v1.py hardcodes training seed42, 8-hour total, 2-hour stage, three fresh trainings and dev24/100000 generated tokens.
findings.required_resolution: Create a separately reviewed future execution version after the current frozen queue exits; do not alter current sources. Make audit seed explicit for 123 and 456 while preserving the exact trainer shuffle and common indices. Bind each new run to its own audit target-token count. Set evaluator CLI max-generated-tokens=900000 and max-wall-seconds=14400 explicitly and controller global=172800; retain system-Python pidfd controller and original project-Python workers. The existing helper sample_indices already accepts a seed, so no sampling-rule change is needed.

findings.topic: Maximum serial stage allowances consume the entire global budget before overhead
evidence: GPU2 waits, full model/source/checkpoint verification, seed-token audits and owned-process cleanup are additional elapsed work.
findings.required_resolution: State explicitly that stage limits are individual ceilings, not reserved guarantees: later stages receive at most the remaining global time and a budget-induced incomplete batch is permitted even when no stage exceeded its individual allowance. Account for verification/waits/audits inside the deadline and predeclare a finite cleanup grace. Do not claim 48 hours accommodates all worst-case stage limits plus overhead, and do not enlarge budgets after outcomes. This clarification does not require increasing the proposed 48-hour ceiling.

reporting_boundary.scientific_failures: Invalid actions, environment termination without success, and 100-step failures remain observed zero outcomes.
reporting_boundary.technical_or_absent: Do not silently recode as zero or drop from a favorable subset; preserve an explicit status for every planned cell and report incomplete confirmation.
reporting_boundary.complete_batch: Only a complete verified 1206-cell batch supports the candidate primary contrasts and practical replication target.
